# Recreation Prompt

Build a single-file mobile portrait canvas arcade game called **Candle Coven: Moonlit Mischief**. Preserve the source loop: a player avatar follows touch/pointer targets, timed items spawn and age from growing to ripe to rotting, ripe item collision awards 10 points, missed ripe items remove one of five lives, zero lives opens a game-over panel, and restart resets play.

Reinterpret the loop as a Hocus Pocus witchy Halloween party. The avatar is a broom-riding witch sister. Items are spell charms: purple brewing sigils while growing, golden moon/spark charms when ripe, brown curse puffs when rotting. Score is **Hex Score** and lives are **Candles**. Use a procedural crescent-moon night courtyard with candles, crooked silhouettes, orange pumpkin warmth, cyan magic highlights, and campy spooky copy. Optimize the HUD and restart CTA for portrait mobile aspect ratios from 4:7 to 9:16.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-first canvas collection/survival arcade game.
- objective: steer a smooth-follow avatar to collect items only after they ripen before they rot.
- input model: pointer/touch down and move on the canvas updates a target position; the avatar lerps toward that target.
- core loop: spawn three initial collectibles, spawn more on a timer, age each collectible from growing to ripe to rotting, collect ripe items by circular collision, add score, lose lives when ripe items rot, render particles and feedback.
- fail/friction state: each missed ripe item costs one life/candle; game over at zero lives; restart resets score, lives, crops, particles, and play state.

## Protected mechanics
- Auto-start into PLAYING state on load.
- Canvas fills the viewport and resizes to mobile portrait.
- Pointer/touch input targets the avatar location without buttons or drag handles.
- Hero speed remains config-driven with the same lerp style.
- Spawn timer, initial three items, non-overlap spawn check, GROWING/RIPE/ROTTING states, GROWTH_TIME 180, ROT_TIME 300, CROP_RADIUS 20, HERO_RADIUS 24, MAX_LIVES 5.
- Ripe collision adds 10 points and removes the item.
- Ripe item timeout costs one life and eventually removes the item.
- Game over at zero lives; restart button restores PLAYING.

## Remixed target
Candle Coven: Moonlit Mischief reframes the same collection/survival loop as a Hocus Pocus-inspired witchy Halloween party. The avatar is a mischievous broom-riding sister sweeping through a candlelit folklore courtyard. Growing items are brewing charms, ripe items are golden spell sparks, rotting items are stale curse puffs. Score is Hex Score; lives are Candles. The scene is a procedural moonlit coven party with candles, crooked silhouettes, stars, spark particles, campy spooky copy, and mobile portrait readability.
